method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Teval decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Teval pages, then filtered for milling, lands from the graveyard and cards leaving the graveyard. Game Changers excluded.
summary: Teval makes a Zombie whenever cards leave your graveyard. Mole Man (play lands from the graveyard) is the standout and is in about half of recent lists. The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
sets.note: Cards Teval players commonly run in Bracket 2 and 3 that aren't in your deck, from EDHREC's bracket pages and average decks. Game Changers removed (Crop Rotation, Cyclonic Rift, Gifts Ungiven, Fierce Guardianship, Demonic Tutor, Rhystic Study, Field of the Dead, Glacial Chasm). Sorted by how often they're played.
